pages.title: Feed and heat
pages.text: The Chlorination Reactor converts metallurgical silicon and hydrogen chloride into crude trichlorosilane. Supply power and magma heat to reach its target temperature of 450.$(br2)Magma cream, magma blocks, and lava buckets can supply heat.

pages.title: Heat supply
pages.text: Magma cream supplies 2,000 heat, a magma block 8,000, and a lava bucket 16,000. These are game units.$(br2)Put fuel in the heat slot. Remove the empty bucket left by lava before supplying the next fuel. Stored heat warms the reactor and replaces heat lost during operation.

pages.title: Pressure
pages.text: Pressure builds during operation. A blocked output does not stop the batch, so keep output slots clear and provide an extraction route.$(br2)At the pressure limit, emergency venting destroys the batch. Resolve output blockages promptly.

pages.title: Next stage
pages.text: Refine crude trichlorosilane in the $(l:siliconic:distillation_tower)distillation tower$(/l). Craft hydrogen chloride from salt, blaze powder, and a glass bottle, or reuse it from chemical recovery.$(br2)Check JEI for the inputs and byproducts of the selected process.
